Adam Smith, in his helpful guidance to Li Hua, recommends the use of removable hooks to hang artwork. This ensures that the walls remain undamaged while allowing Li Hua to enjoy her new decorations. He emphasizes the importance of being careful and using a method that can be easily reversed, should Li Hua decide to change the artwork or remove it at a later time. This demonstrates Adam Smith's supportive and accommodating nature, as he is focused on helping Li Hua enjoy her space without causing harm to it.
